facts.text: Farmer Gill offers Dunk his mule Shamus for 100 gold, or in trade for work such as killing the dragon outside town; he says he would go lower than that, though not yet, and has not agreed to Dunk's offer of 20 gold.

facts.text: Farmer Gill won't lower the mule's price until his sons, away after the dragon, come back, since he can get no work done without them or a mule.
facts.classification: {"blocks_thread":"thread_6","scope_basis":"Gill ties any price drop to his sons' return, which lasts as long as they are away hunting the dragon.","persists_beyond_scene":true,"in_effect":"active"}
